header.closeCompanyBody: The company is saved automatically. You will need the file password to open it again.

help.start: Create a new company, or open a company file you already have. Each company is one file on your computer, protected by its own password. You can copy the file to back it up or send it to your accountant.
help.wizard: Answer a few questions to set up your company. You can go back to any step. Nothing is created until the last step.
help.summary: This is your starting page. It shows your company and will show your key balances once you start recording entries.
help.settings: Choose the language, text size and number style. These settings are saved on this computer.

terms.fiscalYear: The 12-month period your accounts are totalled for. For most businesses it is the calendar year.
terms.baseCurrency: The main currency your books are kept in. Amounts in other currencies are converted into it.
terms.chartOfAccounts: The list of accounts (like Cash, Sales or Rent) that every entry is recorded against.
terms.taxRegistration: The number your tax authority gave your business. It is printed on your invoices.
terms.modules: Optional parts of Baba. Turn on only what you use. You can change this later.
terms.filePassword: Protects your company file. Without it nobody can read the file.

start.title: Welcome to Baba
start.subtitle: Accounting for your business, kept on your computer.
start.emptyBody: Create your first company, or open a file you already have.
start.fileMissing: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
start.pathHelp: Type the full location of the company file.

wizard.title: New company
wizard.nameHelp: Enter at least one name. If you leave one empty, the other is used for both.
wizard.countryHelp: Sets the default currency, tax numbers and starting accounts.
wizard.currencyHelp: Your books are kept in this currency.
wizard.taxesIntro: These numbers are printed on your invoices. They are checked against the format your country uses.
wizard.taxesNone: No tax registration number is needed for {{country}}. You can continue.
wizard.taxInvalid: This number is not in the right format.
wizard.addressHelp: Shown on printed documents. You can change it later.
wizard.chartIntro: Choose the accounts to start with. You can add, rename and move accounts at any time.
wizard.chartBlankHelp: Start with no accounts and add your own.
wizard.modulesIntro: Core accounting is always on. Turn on the extra parts you need.
wizard.passwordIntro: Choose a password for this company file.
wizard.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
wizard.passwordWarning: It cannot be recovered. If you forget it, nobody can open this file, not even us. Write it down and keep it safe.
wizard.filePathHelp: Choose a folder you back up regularly.
wizard.creating: Creating your company… this can take a few seconds.
